seo_description: Exploreans is a small collection of places with character. Adventure, Awe and Authentic in every place, the six things to count on and the seven questions every place answers.
title: A small collection of places with character
lead: Exploreans is defined by what guests live: the walk, the encounter, the stillness, the table. Every place carries the same name, the same promise and the colour of its kind.
alt: The Mara River running over rocks below a wooded escarpment

conviction.title: The experience is the product.
conviction.body: Rooms, food and service matter, and every place delivers them with care. What guests travel for, remember and tell others about is what they lived, so every decision about how Exploreans looks, sounds and behaves starts there.

explorean.headline: Built for the curious traveller

types.name: Adventure seekers
types.body: Out there by day, with real comfort waiting at the end of it.

types.name: Culture lovers
types.body: Here to meet a place and its people, face to face.

types.name: Wellbeing seekers
types.body: Finding rest in movement, nature and stillness.

types.name: Authenticity hunters
types.body: Looking for real experiences and a setting to lose themselves in.

explorean.alt: Whitewashed gazebos and turquoise sunbeds on the sand at the beach club

promise.headline: Six things to count on in every place

items.name: Intimate
items.body: Intimate by design. Personal welcomes, guests known by name and small groups out in the field.

items.name: Rooted
items.body: True to its place and its culture, in what you eat, see and hear.

items.name: Eco-Sensitive
items.body: Light on the land, with deep respect for the natural setting around it.

items.name: Rich in experiences
items.body: Experiences outward and inward, each one led by a qualified person.

items.name: Quality, quietly
items.body: Real comfort and care in every detail, evident in the stay itself.

items.name: Awe
items.body: Memorable stays that inspire you, shaped around the moments worth retelling.

test.headline: Seven questions before a place carries the name
test.body: The Exploreans test decides whether a place can carry the name, anywhere in the world: a river, a reef, a vineyard, a town, a mountain. Every place passes all seven, and every open place is reviewed against them each year.

questions.name: Intimate
questions.question: Does it offer an intimate experience?

questions.name: Adventure
questions.question: Are there real things to do in and around it?

questions.name: Awe
questions.question: Will the setting or the experiences make guests stop and stare?

questions.name: Authentic
questions.question: Is it rooted in its place and its culture?

questions.name: Rich in experiences
questions.question: Are there many experiences on site or within reach?

questions.name: Qualified people
questions.question: Are there qualified people to lead the experiences?

questions.name: Quality built in
questions.question: Can it deliver quality at every touchpoint?
